title: Muharram: the month of Allah
hookLine: the best fasting after Ramadan is in Muharram (Muslim)

cards: After Ramadan, which fast is best? In Sahih Muslim, that question is put to the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, and Abu Hurayrah reports his answer. It doesn't name a single day.
It names a whole month, and gives that month a title you won't find printed on a calendar page. Not the month of the new year. Not the month of fasting.

teach.h: A FAST BY DAY, A PRAYER BY NIGHT.
teach.b: Here is the hadith, in paraphrase: the best fasting after Ramadan is in Allah's month, al-Muharram, and the best prayer after the obligatory prayers is the prayer at night.
One sentence, two offerings: an empty stomach by day, a person standing awake at night. Then the name.
Every month belongs to Allah, Muslims say, so why call this one Allah's month? Some scholars explain it the way they explain the phrase house of Allah for a mosque.
Every place is His, but naming one place after Him lifts it and sets it apart. And Muharram is already one of the four sacred months, the third of the three in a row.
You met it back in year two as the start of the Islamic year, as tradition counts it. Now the part that's easy to miss: none of this is required.
Ramadan's fast is a duty. Muharram's is an offer. The word in the hadith is best, not must.
Nobody is told to fast the whole month. A person can take one day, or a few, and they're stepping into what the hadith praises. So Muharram is an open door at the start of the year.
And it gives the fast a life outside Ramadan. A practice that only happens once a year can start to feel like a costume.
A voluntary day in Muharram says the fast belongs to ordinary time too.

how: Some Muslims keep voluntary fasts during Muharram, following a hadith in Sahih Muslim that calls it Allah's month and praises fasting in it as the best after Ramadan; the fast is voluntary, not required.

o: the sacred month the hadith calls Allah's month, for fasting
the month of the fast that every adult Muslim must keep
the month of the pilgrimage to Makkah each year

p: the best prayer after the obligatory

s: fasting in Muharram is required, like Ramadan
the hadith calls it the best fasting after Ramadan: praised, not required.
the same hadith also praises the prayer at night
the best prayer after the obligatory ones is the prayer at night.
Muharram is one of the four sacred months
it's the third of the three that come in a row.

games.q: someone asks you which fast is best after Ramadan, according to the hadith in Sahih Muslim. what do you say?
games.why: the hadith names a whole month, Muharram, and calls it Allah's month.

practice: If you fast, pick one day this Muharram, or the next time it comes, and see it on the calendar in your mind; if you don't, choose something small to hold back from for one day, a snack, a scroll, a second coffee.
Notice what it's like to choose an offering nobody requires of you. If you pray, you can remember the night prayer the same hadith praises.

wordCard.voice: Muharram. A sacred month, called Allah's month in Sahih Muslim, where voluntary fasting is praised as the best after Ramadan. Today's word.

orig.note: Arabic: Allah's month, al-Muharram, as the hadith calls it.

carryVoice: Your line: allah's month. An offer, not a duty. Back tomorrow, same hill.

sources.ref: Sahih Muslim 1163 (Abu Hurayrah: the best fasting after Ramadan is in Allah's month al-Muharram; the best prayer after the obligatory is the night prayer)
